headline: Operations Analyst | Reporting and Dashboards | Process Improvement

bullets.text: Rebuilt the weekly carrier-performance report from four manual spreadsheets into a single SQL-backed Looker dashboard, cutting preparation from about 6 hours to under 1 hour a week, then used it to run weekly performance reviews with 8 regional carriers.

Mapped the damaged-shipment claims process end to end with customer service and finance, which shortened average claim resolution from 14 days to 9, and wrote a one-page metric glossary with shared SQL views so finance and dispatch report the same on-time delivery numbers.

Own data quality checks across 2,000+ weekly shipments and flag anomalies to dispatch leads, and trained 12 dispatchers on the new dashboard with an internal how-to guide they use to answer their own reporting questions.
Handled 60+ customer tickets a day in Zendesk across order, billing, and delivery issues while keeping customer satisfaction above 94%, balancing speed against the care each type of issue needed.
Built a library of 40+ saved-reply macros that the team adopted as its standard, and tagged ticket drivers every month so the top-three driver report could feed product roadmap reviews.
Scheduled 15 student workers across three service desks each semester, building coverage that kept every desk staffed through the semester's busiest and quietest stretches.
Tracked loans for 300+ laptops and hotspots during remote learning, keeping a clear record of what was out and with whom so students could keep borrowing equipment.
Managed a $12K annual budget for the club and ran the reimbursement process for 20+ events, keeping spending organized and members paid back promptly.
